# `aube cache list-registries`

- **Usage:** `aube cache list-registries`
- **Effect:** read-only

List configured registries from the project + user `.npmrc`.

Prints the registries currently configured for this project, rather than the registry partitions present in the cache.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cache list-registries
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/registry-auth) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->
